observations.title: Moog's Structure Lib role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Provides data-driven structure-generation support for Moog's content modules; the content modules supply structures, placements and loot rather than the library inventing them.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: 3.1.2
